subject: math.AT
name: Seifert-van Kampen theorem
statement: If X=U union V, where U and V are open and U, V, and U intersect V are path connected, then the fundamental group of X is the pushout of the fundamental groups of U and V over that of U intersect V. All groups use a base point in the intersection.

subject: math.AT
name: Classification of covering spaces
statement: For a path-connected, locally path-connected, semilocally simply connected space X, isomorphism classes of connected covering spaces correspond to conjugacy classes of subgroups of its fundamental group. Choosing base points replaces conjugacy classes by individual subgroups.

subject: math.AT
name: Hurewicz theorem
statement: If a CW complex X is (n-1)-connected with n at least two, then H_i(X;Z)=0 for 0<i<n and the Hurewicz map from pi_n(X) to H_n(X;Z) is an isomorphism.

subject: math.AT
name: Whitehead theorem
statement: A map between connected CW complexes that induces isomorphisms on all homotopy groups is a homotopy equivalence.

subject: math.AT
name: Cellular homology theorem
statement: The homology of the cellular chain complex of a CW complex X is naturally isomorphic to its singular homology. Its chain group in degree n is the free abelian group on the n-cells.

subject: math.AT
name: Homotopy invariance of singular homology
statement: Homotopic continuous maps induce the same maps on singular homology with any fixed coefficient group. Consequently, a homotopy equivalence induces isomorphisms on all singular homology groups.

subject: math.AT
name: Long exact sequence of a pair
statement: For a subspace A of X and an abelian coefficient group G, relative singular homology fits into a natural exact sequence with successive terms H_n(A;G), H_n(X;G), H_n(X,A;G), and H_(n-1)(A;G).

references.title: Long exact sequence of a pair

subject: math.AT
name: Excision theorem
statement: Let Z be a subset of A in a pair (X,A) whose closure in X lies in the interior of A. The inclusion (X minus Z, A minus Z) into (X,A) induces isomorphisms on relative singular homology in all degrees, with any fixed coefficient group.

subject: math.AT
name: Mayer-Vietoris theorem
statement: If X is the union of open subspaces U and V, singular homology has a natural long exact sequence with successive terms H_n(U intersect V), H_n(U) direct sum H_n(V), H_n(X), and H_(n-1)(U intersect V), for any fixed coefficient group.

subject: math.AT
name: Universal coefficient theorem for homology
statement: For any space X and abelian group G, there is a natural short exact sequence 0 to H_n(X;Z) tensor G to H_n(X;G) to Tor_1^Z(H_(n-1)(X;Z),G) to 0. The sequence splits, but a splitting need not be natural.

subject: math.AT
name: Universal coefficient theorem for cohomology
statement: For any space X and abelian group G, there is a natural short exact sequence 0 to Ext_Z^1(H_(n-1)(X;Z),G) to H^n(X;G) to Hom_Z(H_n(X;Z),G) to 0. The sequence splits, but a splitting need not be natural.

subject: math.AT
name: Kunneth theorem
statement: For spaces X and Y, the cross product gives a natural short exact sequence from the direct sum of H_p(X;Z) tensor H_q(Y;Z) with p+q=n into H_n(X times Y;Z), whose quotient is the direct sum of Tor_1^Z(H_p(X;Z),H_q(Y;Z)) with p+q=n-1. This sequence splits noncanonically.

subject: math.AT
name: Poincare duality
statement: If M is a closed connected oriented n-dimensional manifold with fundamental class [M], cap product with [M] gives an isomorphism H^k(M;Z) to H_(n-k)(M;Z) for every k.

subject: math.AT
name: Lefschetz fixed-point theorem
statement: Let X be a finite polyhedron and f:X to X continuous. If the alternating sum of the traces of f_* on H_i(X;Q) is nonzero, then f has a fixed point.

subject: math.AT
name: Brouwer fixed-point theorem
statement: Every continuous map from a closed Euclidean n-dimensional ball to itself has a fixed point.

subject: math.AT
name: Hopf degree theorem
statement: For every n at least one, two continuous maps from the oriented sphere S^n to itself are homotopic if and only if they have the same integer degree. Every integer occurs as the degree of such a map.

subject: math.AT
name: Freudenthal suspension theorem
statement: If a based CW complex X is r-connected with r at least one, suspension induces an isomorphism pi_q(X) to pi_(q+1)(Sigma X) for q at most 2r and a surjection for q=2r+1.

subject: math.AT
name: Serre spectral sequence
statement: For a Serre fibration F to E to B with B a simply connected CW complex and F path connected, there is a first-quadrant homology spectral sequence with E^2_(p,q)=H_p(B;H_q(F;Z)) converging to H_(p+q)(E;Z).

subject: math.AT
name: Thom isomorphism theorem
statement: For an oriented real vector bundle of rank r over a CW complex B, cup product with its Thom class gives an isomorphism H^k(B;Z) to H^(k+r)(D(E),S(E);Z). Here D(E) and S(E) are its disk and sphere bundles.

subject: math.AT
name: Representability of ordinary cohomology
statement: For a CW complex X, an abelian group G, and n at least one, H^n(X;G) is naturally in bijection with the homotopy classes of maps from X to an Eilenberg-MacLane space K(G,n). The bijection respects the abelian group structures.
